using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.Cli;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Http;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Http.Modeling;
using Volo.Abp.IO;
using Volo.Abp.Json;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands
{
    [Command(Name, Description, 20)]
    public class GenerateProxyCommand : AsyncAbpCommand<GenerateProxyCommand>
    {
        public const string Name = "generate-proxy";
        public const string Description = "Generate a proxy for a given application";

        private readonly IConsole _console;
        private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

        public GenerateProxyCommand(IConsole console, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _console = console;
            _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CommandLineArgs args)
        {
            var generateProxyArgs = ParseArgs(args);

            using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
            {
                var generator = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IServiceProxyGenerator>();
                await generator.GenerateProxyAsync(generateProxyArgs);
            }
        }

        private GenerateProxyArgs ParseArgs(CommandLineArgs args)
        {
            var generateProxyArgs = new GenerateProxyArgs(
                args.Option("--app-name").Value(),
                args.Option("--app-url").Value(),
                args.Option("--module-name").Value(),
                args.Option("--module-url").Value(),
                args.Option("--service-name").Value(),
                args.Option("--service-url").Value(),
                args.Option("--service-type").Value(),
                args.Option("--output-folder").Value(),
                args.Option("--namespace").Value(),
                args.Option("--with-namespace").HasValue() ? (ServiceType?)Enum.Parse<ServiceType>(args.Option("--with-namespace").Value()) : null,
                args.Option("--without-contracts").HasValue(),
                args.Option("--folder").Value(),
                args.Option("--command-name").Value()
            );

            return generateProxyArgs;
        }
    }
}
